text:
noah: Heads-up: planning a cross-region NIC soft-drain + rolling reboot for eu-north -> eu-central span. Window: Thu 2025-11-13 23:00-01:00 UTC. We'll stagger by rack cohorts to avoid big capacity cliffs.
claire: Can you outline the backfill and routing plan? last time cross-region spikes caused queuing for EU customers.
ben: Proposal: drain non-dedicated pools first, hold a hot-reserve in-region (eu-hot-standby 8 nodes) and warm a secondary pool in us-west as emergency backfill. Enable preemptible burst for 30m only if needed.
irene: Networking: before we soft-drain, flip NIC EEE (energy-efficient ethernet) off on affected ToRs to reduce link flaps. Also prep BGP community stickiness for pinned-dedicated routes.
noah: Runbook (abridged):
```
prep: increase-reserve --pool eu-hot-standby --nodes 8 --duration 3h
prep: warm-pool --region us-west --nodes 6 --purpose emergency-backfill
net: disable-eee --t o r <affected-tor>
cohort-loop:
  cordon cohort --grace 240
  drain cohort --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir
  softdrain-nic --sync 30s
  reboot cohort
  kvseed --pool eu-shadow
  smoke-tests --tags latency,queue
post: re-enable-eee, demote reserves
```
claire: Abort conditions? Need clear SRE cutoffs.
ben: Abort if: node-rejoin failures >1 per cohort OR p95 API latency >225ms for >3m OR eviction rate >4%. SRE oncall (irene) has authority to pause.
irene: I'll run the canary (internal-loadgen + 2 low-traffic tenants) on cohort-0. If kvseed fails or we see kernel NIC errors in dmesg, abort immediately.
noah: Cost check: warm and reserve nodes + burst estimate ~ $950 for the window. @opsbot create a FIN ticket for approval and an INC ticket for the maintenance.
opsbot: Created MAINT-9123 and FIN-6087. Notified finance@redwood and ops-oncall.
claire: Routing tweak: add a temporary smart-routing rule "eu-origin -> prefer eu-hot-standby; fallback to us-west if queue latency >140ms". We'll measure fallback events and log them.
ben: We'll also temporarily increase KV cache TTL and throttle regen to reduce stampede when racks rejoin. Post-window revert TTLs.
noah: Communication: I'll post a short customer blurb tomorrow with a dedicated note for reserved/dedicated tenants. Template: "Planned maintenance (Nov 13 23:00-01:00 UTC). Expect brief evictions/latency; no data loss. Reserved customers will be pinned to standby."
irene: Final prep: canary list, FIN approval, and net ops confirm EEE toggle. Final check at T-45. If green, start at 23:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
